_comment: What packaging/build-deb.sh writes to usr/share/doc/vervellum/copyright and
Third-Party-Notices.txt, through scripts/deb-copyright.py. Paths are relative to
this file. $SWIFT_LICENSE, $SWIFT_VERSION and $SWIFT_TAG come from the toolchain
that built the binary. --static-swift-stdlib links the Swift runtime and
Foundation's ICU into usr/bin/vervellum; scripts/static-runtime-notices.py fails
the build if the binary links anything else, or another ICU major version than

components.name: Swift standard library, Foundation and libdispatch
copyright: Apple Inc. and the Swift project authors
components.comment: Linked by --static-swift-stdlib: the standard library, swift-corelibs-foundation, swift-foundation with swift-collections, libdispatch and swift-foundation-icu's packaging, all under this license. The Runtime Library Exception waives attribution; listed for completeness.

components.name: ICU
copyright: 2016 and later Unicode, Inc. and others
1995-2016 International Business Machines Corporation and others
components.comment: Foundation's ICU code and data, including the break-iterator dictionaries and time zone data whose third-party terms are part of the license text. Not covered by the Swift Runtime Library Exception.
